source.title: Resolve catalog pricing reviews and ad blocks using verified per-variant costs
source.body:
## Live Shopify audit — 2026-10-21
This tracks the requested cleanup of **Needs Review** and **Blocked for Advertising** without bypassing commercial/claims safeguards.

### Verified catalog label counts (Shopify, all statuses)
- `mvq:needs-review`: **82** products; `mvq:pricing:category-review` is present on the reviewed examples and is the dominant driver.
- `mvq:ads:blocked`: **141** products.
  - `mvq:commercial:thin`: **97**
  - `mvq:commercial:healthy`: **37** (paid-ad block arises outside the commercial health state, commonly unresolved category review)
  - `mvq:commercial:blocked`: **7**
- `mvq:ads:eligible`: **40**.
- `mvq:claim-review`: **0** tagged in current Shopify search.
These groups overlap; do not add counts together as if disjoint.

### Actual code paths (main)
- `app/lib/enterprise/product-decision-engine.ts`: `catalogReviewReasons` contains category price exceptions, classification/brand review, source claim review. Any reason forces otherwise-eligible advertising state to `blocked`.
- `app/lib/enterprise/category-pricing.ts`: bands are **advisory merchandising bands, never authority to ignore verified contribution floors**. Review states: above/below band, paid/organic cost conflicts, and multipacks/specialty items.
- `app/lib/enterprise/commercial-health.ts`: paid advertising is blocked if contribution after configured CAC <=0 or after-CAC margin misses target.
- `app/lib/product-processor.ts`: routing/commercial tags are regenerated from decisions; manually deleting tags is not a real fix.

### Safe repair work — do in main only after tests; no new branches
- [ ] Produce a per-product, **per-variant** remediation table with live Shopify IDs, brand route, cost/currency, current prices, category band, paid floor, organic floor, exact review reasons, and proposed change.
- [ ] Separate genuinely unsafe/unverified claims from category price reviews. Do not assume old claim-review counts remain current.
- [ ] For eligible simple-item variants above band, lower toward the category band **only if** the verified organic cost floor, supplier shipping, payment/return reserve, and selected profitability policy permit it; require merchant price approval prior to live changes.
- [ ] For `paid_cost_conflict` and `organic_cost_conflict`, request a sourcing/cost decision instead of overriding margin safeguards.
- [ ] For sets, multipacks, and specialty devices, use item-specific unit-size/variant review. Never apply a one-item ceiling to a set.
- [ ] Leave Miss.Princess products in their separate brand route.
- [ ] Recompute decisions, perform Shopify readback of variant prices, metafields, and routing/advertising tags, run targeted tests/CI, and confirm that cleared holds do not regenerate.
- [ ] Keep all paid ads blocked until commercial proof and publication gates pass. Organic brand/community posts can continue independent of ad budgets.

**Acceptance:** all 82 review records get a reason, owner, and evidenced resolution or explicit unresolved hold; all 141 advertising blocks are categorized and only legitimately fixed items re-evaluate to eligible. No mass tag clearing, fabricated cost data, unsupported claims, or uncontrolled write to Shopify.
